decisions.reason: The same-message MODIFY already records duplicate_and_unused_images_removal_required for Android, so no additional or corrected Event is needed.
Removing duplicate and unused images does not change the independently retained iOS Thinning distribution method.
The image-removal requirement does not alter the Android App Bundle package format, which is already represented by its own same-message Event.
Deleting duplicate and unused images does not change full-app localization coverage or translation-system reconstruction.
The source size-optimization change does not alter Android localization coverage or language-file string alignment.
Image removal has no necessary effect on renewal of iOS signing certificates or signing readiness.
The source change concerns unused image removal and does not change Android RTL layout support.
Removing duplicate and unused images does not change the iOS version target, UIWebView replacement, or API-modernization requirements.
Message 38 does not resolve whether the Youku video should remain or be removed; the explicit client decision occurs later and cannot be used here.
The image-removal change does not alter the independently required iOS Privacy Manifest.
Removing duplicate and unused images does not change the requirement for iOS RTL layout support.
The source size-optimization change does not alter Android API level, dependency updates, or deprecated-API refactoring.
